layout_fit.reason: Pinned final-spec 77x47 frames show complete graph labels and boxes at natural 100%, while actual live panes are honestly recorded as 83x51. conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Actual hue families and proximity group ISP/MUX/core, firewall/border-leaf/spine, and spine/leaf/rack concepts without arbitrary depth cycling. But this category explicitly requires source-defined tiers to be respected, and D1 violates the corrected spine-above-both-leaf-classes tier relationship. border_integrity.reason: Ordinary and all-selected native ANSI stills prove complete, color-continuous perimeters for all 22 node occurrences: 452 perimeter cells. animation.reason: Applicable as an explicit prohibition, not N/A: original human line 134 removes flowing dots and the frozen case manifest says animation off. Every supplied capture has zero U+25CF glyphs. All 28 specs set dots:0; five native and five pinned timestamped frame screens per view show zero dots and stable glyphs. No speed, origin, same-arrival, or full-lap motion proof is needed for these explicitly static routes.
